comparisons.contextual_baseline: none selected; native-label/projected-label metrics must be separately named after preregistration
comparisons.missing_strata: unavailable with reason; synthetic fixtures test engineering contracts only
comparisons.policy: no comparison until independent labels and approved context available; preserve existing four-level and new three-level schemes separately
comparisons.structured_baseline: A1 four kinds only; report unsupported target coverage, never use absent general NER as eight-class semantic baseline

freeze_and_publication.before_scoring: freeze candidate/model/config/artifact/ontology on training/development evidence before B2; final untouched holdout independent of any such selection
freeze_and_publication.private_artifacts: ignored research/local only; no raw text/private packets/models/datasets in Git
freeze_and_publication.protocol_digest: SHA-256 of this file bytes recorded in report; changes require new version/evidence before scoring

input_contract.extraction: existing bounded TXT/PDF/DOCX research.documents only; no OCR or channel changes
input_contract.failures: every failure/truncation retained in all-input coverage denominator; not a negative
input_contract.input: raw extracted text only; no oracle spans/labels/IDs/metadata/filenames supplied to detector
input_contract.no_predictions: OK complete extraction plus an empty prediction list is valid; unavailable extraction/model remains abstention
input_contract.offsets: Unicode code points, start inclusive/end exclusive; original text digest binds offsets; no normalization before matching
input_contract.oversized: exclude from full-document conditional metrics; no silent truncation or new chunking
input_contract.partial_extraction: no full-document metrics; partial-prefix diagnostic must carry original/prefix digests and a separate denominator
input_contract.result_truncation: score the actual first 100 returned predictions; all in-scope gold remains in recall denominator; also report truncation stratum

matching.ontology: only identical declared target semantics; no TAB CODE-to-credential or QUANTITY-to-financial-level alias; spaCy label projection requires a separate pre-score contract
matching.primary: exact one-to-one match on document/start/end/type; duplicate identical predictions collapsed with duplicate count reported
matching.relaxed_overlap: not used in primary result; new declared diagnostic/version required
matching.typed_errors: wrong type at exact boundary is FP predicted type and FN reference type; no oracle reclassification

metrics.category: typed exact span metrics measure end-to-end category; category accuracy conditional on exact detected boundaries is secondary with matched-boundary coverage
metrics.coverage: all inputs, complete extraction, reviewed eligible reference, detector available, result cap/truncation, unknown/abstention and exclusion reasons; all-input observable FN count/coverage separate from conditional extraction success
metrics.document: any in-scope candidate vs any in-scope independently reviewed target; release-relative binary result separately labeled; TP/FP/FN/TN per kind/category, FP documents/1000 eligible documents and FPR=FP/(FP+TN) separate
metrics.pr_auc: average precision only when meaningful ranked scores and >=5 positive/5 negative independent documents exist; deterministic candidates have no AP/probability claim
metrics.small_samples: report counts/class/family support; intervals conditional on corpus/model; no general organizational accuracy claim
metrics.span: per-target TP/FP/FN, precision=TP/(TP+FP), recall=TP/(TP+FN), F1=2TP/(2TP+FP+FN); micro from sums; macro over prespecified targets with nonzero denominator, report included/undefined target list
metrics.true_negatives: span TN/accuracy/specificity undefined because no fixed universe of negative spans
metrics.uncertainty: 2000 family-cluster percentile bootstrap replicates, seed 42, 95% intervals; whole family resampled; report valid replicates and null for undefined; <2 families no interval
metrics.undefined: zero denominator => null plus reason; F1 zero with FP or FN is valid; precision null when no predictions, recall null when no gold

population.B1_action: freeze separately versioned development population; audit all family, source, subject, container/version, exact/normalized/near-duplicate and annotation coverage relations first
population.development_partition: retain train for fit and official dev for development selection; whole family in at most one partition; dev wins cross train/dev family conflicts
population.development_pool: original train/dev only; exclude every family touching historical test using frozen DS2 group manifest; do not move official validation into training
population.disagreements: exclude whole disputed document from primary full-text reference metrics; preserve all competing annotations, no generated gold
population.duplicates: same source/container/version/subject or NFKC casefold alphanumeric text hash; exhaustive five-word shingle Jaccard >=0.8 review trigger; transitive family closure
population.final_test: separate authorized new family-safe natural holdout held by custodian; not pilot or historically inspected TAB/CERT test
population.historical_test: DS2 test and DS3 diagnostics already exposed; immutable historical evidence only; no new untouched-test claim
population.overlaps: retain original spans; flat nonoverlap model uses explicitly named nonoverlap-doc subset plus separately reported excluded documents; never silently flatten gold
population.prevalence: retain natural eligible population; no balancing evaluation; report exclusions with denominators
population.reference_gate: reviewed source sets plus guideline intent for release-relative metrics; independent exhaustive reviews required for natural target accuracy/negative claims
population.selection: no family/population/exclusion decision based on model prediction or score; insufficient target support remains unavailable

resources.future_model_probe: CPU only, one worker/one numerical thread, <=2GiB address space, <=5 CPU seconds and <=8 wall seconds per bounded document; model load measured separately with <=60s wall; failure explicit
resources.measurements: artifact/load hash, versions, dependency compatibility, cold load and warm inference median/p95/max on common inputs, peak RSS, processed chars and status counts
resources.resource_failure: preserve evidence; revised bounds/config requires new preregistration before any selection/scoring

contextual_detection.reference: TAB released human-reviewed machine-assisted annotations, explicitly release-relative; independent completeness not established

organizational_sensitivity.reference: independent authorized document reviews and owner-approved versioned policy/context

structured_detection.reference: independent exhaustive target-kind span review on authorized natural text; candidates do not establish identities/accounts/secrets

supplied_span_category.new_scoring: none; not a raw-text detector comparison
